column1: # agent-system 2.0 install manifest (SPEC-2.0.md § B8): the machinery table, machine-read.
# One row per artifact under a machinery directory: path (repo-relative), kind, destination.
# install/install.sh fails when a file under a machinery directory has no row here, or when any
# symbolic link sits under one. Exactly one ledger-schema row (ledger/schema.sql, the file the
# module applies), one ledger-init row, one ledger-backup row and one ledger-backup-agent row.
# Paths are case-sensitive literals, not globs, including spaces and backslashes. Duplicate and
# coverage checks use keyed lookups rather than rescanning a growing path list for every artifact;
# filesystem and symbolic-link checks still run before any installed state is written.
# destination: "-" = used in place from the checkout, nothing is copied or linked;
#              only, never loaded by the installer.
# Columns are separated by one TAB. Lines starting with # are comments.
# M3/M4 (2026-09-29): tier files, the classifier and gates extensions with their modules, tests and
# data, and the 2.0 profile template (config.yml + models.yml, the judge pin). All used in place:
# the profile names the extension entry points by repo path. `profile` rows are the template the
# profile rendering is owned by M6 (MIGRATION.md; corrected 2026-09-29 from "M8"); models.yml must land beside config.yml.
# Linux (later addition, not built): a systemd user timer running the ledger-backup row, e.g.
# {systemd_user}/<name>. Until it exists, off macOS the open-time copy is the only schedule.
# Guard A (wl-mv4yf3zgf9lm2o): every bun test run from a module root or a test dir preloads
# ledger/test/isolate-preload.ts (a temp HOME and ledger). The root bunfig.toml is outside every machinery dir.
# Migration items one file each (wl-mv5mvvs64ahq0w): the numbering tool .github/workflows/migration-number.yml runs.
# The suggest-only pair trigger (wl-mv67564rdkfvnk PR 1): the jev ask, the signals and offer, the read-only report.
# Base-prompt voice and contract (migration/items/base-prompt-voice-contract.md): bin/as2 renders the
# orchestrator's --append-system-prompt file with this script, so every turn sends the same system prompt.
# Test runner self-refresh (migration/items/test-runner-self-refresh.md): row 6 pins for the refresh helper's sudo forms.
# Openable links (migration/items/openable-links.md): render-only linking and the local herdr action.
# Jev ranking, show-only first (migration/items/jev-ranking.md): the ranking, the as2_rank tool, the audit, the launch gate, the CLIs.
# Intake queue (migration/items/intake-queue.md): queued asks wait in rank order and launch when a slot frees.
# Phoenix tracing (wl-mv65t5d34lts00): the tracing switch (reader, word, tests) and the Phoenix LaunchAgent,
# on by default. install/phoenix-agent.sh fills and loads the plist; install.sh runs it (step 6e).
# Agent channel, phase 1 (migration/items/agent-channel.md): Plumb sends Ilex notes and proposals through
# the OMP seat mailbox; never authored as Jo. Loaded by surface/index.ts for the orchestrator only.
# Jo's plugins (wl-mv8r90k9nci4qo, 2026-10-14; re-pinned with paired-coding added, wl-mvb9mw00ycfjeo,
# 2026-10-19): i-have-audhd, ask-graham and paired-coding vendored from jo-wolff-plugins at the one pin in
# plugins/VENDOR.md, upstream *.test.mjs left out. All used in place: profile/config.yml loads
# plugins/index.ts (AuDHD and Graham in the orchestrator and lanes, paired-coding in by-hand lanes, none in

# hands) and lists each plugins/

/skills dir. plugins/paired-as2.ts is as2's seam to the paired adapter.
